chronology.notes: Ragweed rise above 50 cm., 1 C-14 date and spruce decline date from C.T.Shay Age bounds for application of the model: top = 0; bottom = 10500.
Chron uses surface (-10 BP), Ambrosia-rise at 35 cm (70 BP), radiocarbon date (4270 BP) at 552.5 cm, and top of the Picea zone (10000 BP) at 1052.5 cm.

A 300-yr reservoir was subtracted from the radiocarbon age. Based on IntCal13 calibration curve.
